correctness.rationale: The exact independent lognormal second-moment factors and positive heat semigroup give the displayed two-by-two covariance matrix. Perron–Frobenius rigorously dominates the antisymmetric moment mode. A monotonic Perron crossing, explicit determinant, and fully factored strictly negative second derivative establish the exact sharp critical noise curve and its one-interval law. The continuous Itô moment generator has exact leading eigenvalue and sharp threshold 3b. An exact rational witness demonstrates the strict stable-continuous/unstable-split discrepancy. The bundled rational and numerical verifier was executed successfully; the infinite-parameter proof is analytical.

value.rationale: The exact phase diagram pinpoints a practically motivated and counterintuitive failure: every numerical step preserves nonnegative states but the long-time numerical mean-square norm grows even when the underlying two-site Itô stochastic heat flow is exponentially mean-square stable. The monotone threshold gives a concrete and sharp timestep-selection condition rather than a narrow unmotivated invariant; an exact rational witness supports its interpretation.
